crossRefs.note: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called…
Yahweh, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned…
I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and…
Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.
I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.
All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

translations.web: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.
translations.bsb: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them.
translations.kjv: PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep
translations.asv: PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful; Therefore doth my soul keep them.
